## About
In-N-Out Lube is a family-owned and operated auto repair shop here in Fort Worth. We take care of the everyday work that keeps your car on the road: oil changes, state inspections, brake service, transmission work and electrical system testing.
With a full-service oil change, we check all the fluids in your vehicle and fill your tires. Along with Fort Worth, we also serve Lake Worth. Our customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 259 Google reviews.

## Services
- Full-service oil change: An oil change that also covers filling your tires, checking all fluids and an inspection.
- State inspection: State vehicle inspections for Fort Worth drivers.
- Brake service: We inspect, replace and install new brake pads and rotors.
- Transmission and electrical system service: Transmission work and electrical system testing.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate before you do the work?
A: Yes. Call us for a free estimate on our auto services.

Q: Do you have any oil change deals?
A: Yes. Ask about $3 off your next oil change service.

Q: Can you help with an inspection for a car from out of state?
A: One reviewer said Doug helped them through the inspection process for an out-of-state vehicle, including working through issues with the state system. Give us a call and we can talk it over.
